title: IceCure Medical (ICCM) New Cryoablation System Gets FDA Nod - Zacks Investment Research
description: IceCure Medical has received FDA clearance for its next-generation cryoablation system, XSense, which is designed for minimally invasive cryoablation procedures. The approval marks a significant step for the company, as it aims to solidify its position as a global leader in cryoablation solutions.

title: Inspire Medical (INSP) Dips on FDA Recall of IPG Model 3028 - Zacks Investment Research
description: Inspire Medical Systems has issued a recall of its Inspire IV Implantable Pulse Generator (IPG) Model 3028 due to a critical manufacturing defect that can lead to electrical leakage, system malfunctions, and severe health consequences. The recall is classified as the most serious type by the FDA, and it may impact the company's future sales.

title: Reasons to Add Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) to Your Portfolio Now - Zacks Investment Research
description: Intuitive Surgical is well-poised for growth due to its strength in robotics and progress on the AI front, but faces supply constraints that may hurt its performance. The company's da Vinci surgical system and advancements in AI are driving growth, but supply chain issues are a concern.

title: IceCure's (ICCM) ProSense Breast Cancer Study Meets Endpoint - Zacks Investment Research
description: IceCure Medical's ProSense cryoablation system has shown promising results in treating breast cancer, with a 100% complete ablation rate and no complications in an outpatient setting. The study supports the use of cryoablation as a minimally invasive, outpatient treatment option for breast cancer patients.

title: Here's Why You Should Add DaVita (DVA) to Your Portfolio - Zacks Investment Research
description: DaVita Inc. (DVA) has been gaining from its business model and acquisition of dialysis centers, leading to a strong first-quarter 2024 performance. However, concerns persist regarding its dependence on commercial payers and macroeconomic challenges.

title: Reasons to Retain Cardinal Health (CAH) in Your Portfolio Now - Zacks Investment Research
description: Cardinal Health Inc. is well-positioned for growth, driven by its acquisition strategy, diversified product portfolio, and strong pharmaceutical segment. However, inflationary pressure remains a concern for the company.

title: 3 Reasons to Retain Inogen (INGN) Stock in Your Portfolio Now - Zacks Investment Research
description: Inogen, Inc. is well-poised for growth in the portable oxygen concentrator (POC) market, driven by a strong product portfolio and solid Q1 2024 performance. However, the company faces stiff competition and forex volatility, which are major downsides.

title: Reasons to Retain Veeva Systems (VEEV) in Your Portfolio Now - Zacks Investment Research
description: Veeva Systems is well-positioned for growth due to its strong product portfolio and strategic deals, but faces challenges from stiff competition and data security threats. The company's first-quarter fiscal 2025 performance and growth projections are positive, but rising costs and estimate trends are concerns.

title: Terumo (TRUMY) Unit's SOFAST Study Shows Positive Results - Zacks Investment Research
description: Terumo's subsidiary MicroVention announced positive results from the SOFAST study, which evaluated the efficacy and safety of the SOFIA Flow Plus Aspiration Catheter in treating acute ischemic stroke. The study showed high rates of good functional outcomes and successful revascularization, setting a new standard for stroke thrombectomy devices.

title: BD (BDX) Up on Efforts to Tackle Blood Culture Vial Shortage - Zacks Investment Research
description: Becton, Dickinson and Company (BDX) has gained 0.9% since July 10 after announcing reduced availability of blood culture vials due to issues with its supplier. The company is taking immediate measures to mitigate the supply disruption, including leveraging its manufacturing expertise and collaborating with the FDA.

title: 4 Healthcare Stocks Poised to Beat Q2 Earnings Estimates - Zacks Investment Research
description: The healthcare sector is expected to see strong growth in earnings and revenue for the second quarter of 2024, driven by factors like rising patient volumes, premium rate hikes, and technological advancements. Four healthcare stocks - The Cigna Group, Universal Health Services, HCA Healthcare, and Tenet Healthcare - are identified as potential outperformers based on their Earnings ESP and Zacks Rank.

title: Elanco (ELAN) Stock Declines After Sale of Aqua Business - Zacks Investment Research
description: Elanco Animal Health has divested its aqua business to Merck Animal Health for $1.3 billion, enabling the company to focus on pet health and livestock sustainability while reducing its debt burden.

title: HCA Healthcare (HCA) Beats on Q2 Earnings, Ups 2024 EPS View - Zacks Investment Research
description: HCA Healthcare reported strong Q2 2024 results, with adjusted EPS of $5.50 beating estimates and revenues of $17.5 billion growing 10.3% year-over-year. The company benefited from rising admissions and higher inpatient and outpatient surgeries, though rising expenses partially offset the positives.

title: Merit Medical (MMSI) Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat, '24 View Up
description: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. reported better-than-expected Q2 2024 results, with adjusted EPS up 16.8% year-over-year and revenues increasing 5.6%. The company saw growth across its Cardiovascular and Endoscopy segments, and raised its full-year 2024 guidance.

title: Baxter (BAX) Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, '24 EPS View Raised
description: Baxter International Inc. reported better-than-expected Q2 2024 earnings, with adjusted EPS of 68 cents beating the consensus estimate. Revenue also topped expectations, driven by growth across the company's business segments. The company provided positive guidance for Q3 and full-year 2024.

title: Butterfly Network's Stock Surges on iQ3 Device Launch in Europe
description: Butterfly Network's stock surged 26.9% after the company announced the commercial launch of its third-generation handheld point-of-care ultrasound system, Butterfly iQ3, in Europe. The device's strong uptake in the U.S. market and its advanced features are driving investor optimism.

title: Ensign Adds 8 Facilities in Kansas & Colorado to Expand Footprint
description: The Ensign Group has acquired the operations of a nursing facility in Kansas and seven nursing facilities in Colorado, expanding its footprint in these states. The acquisitions are expected to increase the company's revenues and profits.

title: Cigna Stock Gains 26% in a Year: What Lies Ahead for Investors?
description: Cigna's stock has gained 25.6% in the past year, outperforming the industry and the broader market. The company's strong membership base, Evernorth unit, acquisitions, and expanding cash reserves have contributed to its growth. Analysts expect Cigna's earnings and revenues to continue growing in the coming years.

title: Behavioral Rehabilitation Market to Reach $777.2 Billion, Globally, by 2033 at 6.3% CAGR: Allied Market Research
description: The global behavioral rehabilitation market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 6.3% from 2024 to 2033, driven by the increasing prevalence of mental health disorders, rise in government initiatives and funding, and availability of customized treatment plans.

title: FMS Stock Rides on Diversified Portfolio and Restructuring Initiatives
description: Fresenius Medical Care (FMS) is benefiting from improving treatment volumes, stabilizing labor environment in the U.S., and operational improvements from its restructuring initiatives. The company's diversified portfolio and expansion efforts in home dialysis and new markets are also driving growth.

title: Behavioral Rehabilitation Market to Witness 6.9% CAGR by 2031 | SkyQuest Technology
description: The behavioral rehabilitation market is expected to grow rapidly, driven by increasing mental health awareness and the rising global addiction crisis. The substance abuse disorder segment dominates the market, with a focus on personalized treatments and innovations in telemedicine. North America leads the market due to high awareness of dementia and a strong healthcare system.
